alex: Hey @maria_finance — quick help? I took a last-minute train for a client meeting on 3/18. Vendor (rail-express) issued a partial refund but the corpcard shows both the original charge and a pending negative line. Seeing odd final balance. I uploaded the receipts (scan + vendor refund email). Charge IDs below:

alex: Original charge: `CHG-9081723` $132.40
alex: Refund posted: `RFND-9081723-PART` -$45.00 (pending)

alex: Do we need to do a manual reversal or will the pending clear and net correctly? Also worried this will block recon for Samir (he's working monthly corpcard close).

maria_finance: Thanks for the details. Can you paste the vendor refund email text or attach the PDF? If the merchant issued a merchant-initiated refund it usually settles in 3-5 business days; pending negative then disappears once cleared. Did the refund hit the same card last four `4321`? :thinking:

alex: Yep last4 4321. Refund email snippet: "We have issued a partial refund of $45.00 to card ending 4321 for delay compensation. Refund reference RFND-9081723-PART." Uploaded as `train_refund_0318.pdf`.

maria_finance: Ok. For now tag the expense as `pending_refund` in the expense report and leave the original receipt attached. Samir — when you do month close, please exclude `CHG-9081723` from reimbursable until refund clears. I'll mark a reconciliation note on the corpcard ledger.

samir: Got it. How do I tag `pending_refund` in Concur? I only see `submitted`, `approved`, `reimbursed` options.

maria_finance: Use the `notes` field on the expense line and prefix with `PENDING_REFUND:` (all caps). I'll pick it up in the ledger review. Also cc your manager for FYI.

alex: @emily can you confirm manager approval? It was an emergency travel approved verbally. I have the manager slack note attached as screenshot.

emily: Confirmed — I approved the trip via Slack on 3/17. No personal funds used. :white_check_mark:

maria_finance: Great. I'll monitor the pending refund. If it doesn't clear in 7 business days I'll escalate to card issuer ops to force a merchant follow-up. If they need us to issue a chargeback we'll coordinate with legal.

expense-bot: Expense report `EXP-74291` created for alex with status `submitted`.

alex: Thanks all. Not urgent but wanted to avoid a surprise negative recon. Appreciate the workflow notes. :pray:
